whyItMatters: apex code selects MD5 (Crypto.generateDigest('MD5', body)), whose collisions defeat security reliance on the resulting digest.
actions: Replace the MD5 selection with 'SHA-256' wherever the digest is security-relevant.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified MD5 selection, and security digests verify under the replacement.
